meta.method: Pass 1: news-first sweep of wet-season months (Apr–Nov) using Task 26 outlets and qualifying rule. Pass 2 (slimmed 2026-10-18): death queries with no site filter; Oyan Dam / Ogun River / lagoon / water-release / Isheri-Ajegunle-Owode-Agboyi queries; Anadolu once per year; out-of-season Jan–Mar and Dec. Qualifying reports name a Lagos State place and a date, and describe water on streets or in homes. Quotes ≤25 words, verbatim, and taken only from that report's own URL. Dates, numbers and quotes are only those in the source. Areas left as named; not geocoded. Flood date is the flood day, not publication day.
notes: Punch 2015 flood URLs largely unresolved after the site redesign; pass 1 still queried site:punchng.com each month. No qualifying Punch street/home flood day found that still reads.
January: Punch coastal-pupils/lagoon-tide travel piece is not a dated street/home flood. Channels/Vanguard NEMA 8,046 South-West victims are fire and windstorm (Iwaya, Berlin/Marina). Excluded.
February: no Task 26 street/home flood day found.

March (out of season): Guardian 18 Mar — last week's downpour, overflowing Arigbanla Canal flooded Orile-Agege streets (Oko-Oba, Alaramimo, Alexandra, Egbatedo, Adelekan, Shoritire Close) and destroyed cars; Aboru, Egbeda, Abesan, Ayobo, Abule-Egba, Akowonjo also named. Fashola visited Papa-Ashafa at the weekend after a rainstorm. No death reported. Kept.
April: Nairametrics/Nation Tunji Bello seasonal rainfall prediction (Marina 1,824mm). Warnings only. Excluded.
May: Nation (not Task 26) Adenekan dredging inspection. No Task 26 dated street/home flood day found.

June 9–10: Vanguard Adenekan relocate advice (lagoon/river back-flow). Warning with a file photo of Ogudu; excluded as a standalone report. Same warning is cited inside the 17 Jun Vanguard piece that is kept.

Mid-June: Vanguard 17 Jun — floods over the last few weeks; residents sacked from homes; Satellite Town roads flooded this rainy season (shops on drains). Adenekan: rains since March, lagoon and river back-flow. Kept, date_confidence approx.

Guardian 21 Jun ('Rains of Pains'): past month of downpours; Iyana Ejigbo stretch flooded and impassable; Coconut bus stop and Point Road Apapa flood when it rains. Kept, date_confidence approx. Okota Alhaji Olusesi Street is potholes, not used as a flood area.

Weekend 20–21 Jun (Sat–Sun) into Monday 22 Jun: Daily Trust — three-day downpour; cars stuck in drainages Sat–Sun; houses submerged at Apapa, Amukoko, Badia, Mushin, Itire, Agege, Okoko; Ijora-Badia and Isolo residents moving property; Apapa end of Oshodi Expressway almost cut off; Mile 2–Apapa and Agege Motor Road gridlock; VGC, Lekki, Ikoyi approach roads waterlogged. 'No life has been reported lost in the flooding.' 14 Ijaye Street, Agege mud house collapsed over the weekend (Farinloye: no casualty); collapse is in impacts, deaths is null. Vanguard 21 Jun is the collapse only; not kept as a flood report.
Vanguard 23 Jun Ajegunle: roads/potholes visit last Monday; 'every rainy season, we are sacked by flood' is perennial. Excluded as chronic roads, not a dated flood day.
Nairametrics 27 Jun LSPWC 90-road repairs after recent downpour: no named flooded street/home. Excluded.
July 19 Guardian Sunday: photos of flooding in Apapa; Ajegunle (Opeleye Street shop destroyed), Mile 2, Apapa; flood entered a house. No weekday. date_confidence approx. No death reported.

P.M. News 22 Jul editorial says Monday last week (13 Jul) rain claimed lives and left 200+ homeless. Not a Task 26 outlet. Punch/Vanguard/Guardian/Daily Trust/Channels did not confirm a dated 13 Jul street/home flood or named-source death. Lead only.
August: Onisarotu Lagdo Dam (Cameroon) warning. Forecast. Excluded. Starconnect 24 Aug photo of Ogunnusi Road, Ojodu that morning is not a Task 26 outlet.

September: Alpha Beach/Okun Alfa ocean flood is Nairaland/BellaNaija (30 Sep). Lead only; no Task 26 confirmation. Premium Times 20 Sep national flood deaths are northern states, not Lagos. Anadolu 22 Sep is Kaduna. Vanguard 'Preparing against flood' is a warning. No qualifying September day.
October: Onisarotu/TheNEWS heavy-rain warning. Guardian 22 Oct Swamp Street Lagos Island collapse is not a flood. No qualifying October day.

Saturday 7 Nov: Daily Trust (8 Nov) — 2:30pm downpour took over Lagos–Abeokuta Expressway at Alagbado; vehicles submerged; filling station taken over; ~30 minutes before the road reopened. Same Saturday: Maryland Road, Ikeja, flooded. Lack of drainage on the expressway (residents/motorists). No death in this article.

Same morning 7 Nov: mudslide at Orisha Street, Isheri Magodo (Ojodu Berger) killed four Odiah siblings. Vanguard, Channels, Anadolu: Farinloye — mud detached from a hill beside River Ogun during heavy rain. deaths is not attached; mudslide is not a flood drowning (same call as 2016 Agidingbi). Not kept as a flood report.
December: Guardian 17 Dec Oke Afa / Peace Home Valley Estate perennial flooding; no dated 2015 flood day. Nation (not Task 26) same community. Excluded.

Oyan Dam / Ogun River 2015: Tunji Bello '30.00m of the Ogun Riverbanks' is The Nation 24 Sep 2014, not 2015. No 2015 Oyan-release street/home flood found in Task 26 outlets. Anadolu year query: no 2015 Lagos flood day.
TVC, BBC Pidgin: no dated 2015 Lagos street/home flood post reached (BBC Pidgin launched 2017). X:LASEMA/MoE/NEMA: not reached.
No 2015 flood death with a named person or named office in a qualifying report. Unnamed witnesses are not used for who_reported.

reports.impacts: Last week's downpour: overflowing Arigbanla Canal flooded surrounding Orile-Agege streets and destroyed property including cars, valued at millions of naira. Rain started in the early hours. Other mainland areas named as worst hit: Aboru, Egbeda, Abesan, Ayobo, Abule-Egba, Akowonjo road. No death reported. Fashola inspected Papa-Ashafa, Agege, at the weekend after a rainstorm that damaged property.
reports.quote: the overflowing Arigbanla Canal, which was recently reconstructed by the Lagos State government, flooded the surrounding streets
reports.cause_quote: don't dump them in the drains, they would constrict the drains that we have built
reports.cause_who: Babatunde Fashola, Governor of Lagos State

reports.impacts: Over the last few weeks: floods from heavy downpour (often early morning to mid-evening); several residents sacked from their homes; traffic snarls. Ejike Agwuegbo, Satellite Town: roads in the neighbourhood flooded this rainy season, still flooded even when it does not rain for days. Dapo Oluwa, Atiporomeh, Badagry: access roads no-go areas in the rainy season (fear of a major disaster; not itself a counted death). No death reported.
reports.quote: several residents have been sacked from their homes
reports.cause_quote: the rains had led to the rise in water level of the lagoons and rivers as a result of back-flow
reports.cause_who: Ayodeji Adenekan, Permanent Secretary, Office of Drainage Services
reports.review_note: 2026-10-18 reviewer: a roundup ('over the last few weeks' / 'in the past month') with no identifiable flood day; date_confidence set to period.

reports.impacts: Lagos in the past month: several downpours. Iyana Ejigbo: an entire stretch of the road flooded and impassable; motorists forced one way. Coconut bus stop: the road becomes flooded whenever rain falls. Point Road, Apapa: the entire street becomes flooded when it rains. No death reported.
reports.quote: an entire stretch of the road has become flooded and impassable
reports.cause_quote: The absence of gutters on either side of the road causes flowing water to run on the road
reports.review_note: 2026-10-18 reviewer: a roundup ('over the last few weeks' / 'in the past month') with no identifiable flood day; date_confidence set to period.

reports.impacts: Downpour for the past three days (published Monday 22 Jun): cars and trucks stuck in drainages on Saturday and Sunday; several houses at Apapa, Amukoko, Badia, Mushin, Itire, Agege and Okoko submerged. Ijora-Badia: residents salvaging property. Isolo: residents moving property to safer places. Some weak-foundation houses brought down by flood. Apapa end of Oshodi Expressway almost completely cut off. Gridlock on Mile 2–Apapa expressway and Agege motor road. Pedestrians stranded; Tin-Can to Mile 2 on foot or bikes. Approach roads to VGC, Lekki and Ikoyi submerged. 'Although no life has been reported lost in the flooding.' Over the weekend a 50-year-old mud house at 14 Ijaye Street, Agege, collapsed after rainwater entered the foundation; Farinloye said no casualty. Collapse is in impacts, not a flood death.
reports.quote: Several cars and trucks were seen stuck in drainages on Saturday and Sunday
reports.cause_quote: Most parts of Lagos metropolis have been taken over by flood following the continued downpour

reports.impacts: Photographs of flooding in Apapa. Tunde Owolabi, trader, Opeleye Street, Ajegunle: shop destroyed by flood. Ola Opeyemi: flood entered his house and destroyed his property. Residents of Ajegunle, Mile 2 and Apapa ask the state to clear blocked canals. No death reported. No weekday given for the photographed flood.
reports.quote: It is unacceptable that homes are still being submerged in Lagos.
reports.cause_quote: People have blocked drainage channels provided some years ago with refuse, or have built houses on them
reports.cause_who: Tunde Owolabi, trader, Opeleye Street, Ajegunle

reports.impacts: Yesterday (Saturday 7 Nov, published Sunday): rain from about 2:30pm took over parts of Lagos–Abeokuta Expressway; many vehicles submerged. Correspondent saw commercial buses and cabs towards Sango-Ota and Tollgate submerged in the flood at Alagbado. One carriageway locked; the other passable at a snail's pace. About 30 minutes before the road reopened. A filling station taken over by water. Same Saturday: Maryland road in Ikeja virtually closed; motorists spent hours on the flooded road. No death reported in this article.
reports.quote: A heavy downpour in Lagos yesterday took over some parts of Lagos-Abeokuta expressway with many vehicles submerged
reports.cause_quote: Residents and motorists attribute the downpour to lack of proper drainage in the expressway
